scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Endex is an Excel add-in that builds financial models and helps update existing workbooks with source-linked notes.
explains_well: The film shows both a blank-sheet build and an existing model, then opens a source document from the analysis.
unclear: The long full-window recording makes small changes hard to follow, and no single changed assumption is traced through its formula to a result.
scenario: Build a model in Excel or update an existing one using current information.
product_clear_basis: The founders explicitly identify an AI agent that lives in Excel.

comparison.story: Name the product and establish the team. → Show creation from a blank workbook. → Demonstrate model structure and breadth. → Emphasize linked drivers and editability as claims. → Show work on an existing model. → Show a path from model analysis to source material. → Set expectations and provide access action. → Tie the product name to its host application.
